manifest.coverage: Four original source byte hashes and six substantive observation/report/ledger byte hashes.

permission_contract.application_scope: Only the newly created PhaseA directory and its eight files.
permission_contract.method: Remove all write bits recursively from this new owned directory, then verify modes and hashes.
permission_contract.limits: Ordinary filesystem permission seal only. An owner can deliberately change permissions. No signature, independent witness, or immutable flag is claimed.

verification_contract.source_hashes: Opaque byte hash comparison only; no additional image payload, metadata read, decode, or measurement.
verification_contract.entry_set: Exactly the eight named entries in the manifest.
verification_contract.text_integrity: Parse authored JSON and verify the usage ledger's four-event and zero-prohibited-operation bounds.
verification_contract.seal_self_hash: Opaque SHA-256 reported in the final TEXT-only handoff after write bits are removed.

handoff_boundary.output: Frozen source inventory/report, ledger, hashes, and this permission seal only.
handoff_boundary.return: TEXT ONLY; no image payloads returned.
handoff_boundary.stop: After PhaseA; no subsequent candidate or source-image work authorized here.
handoff_boundary.sessions: No background or persistent session started; all commands must exit before final handoff.

approval: NONE: no whole-source, crop, lesson, scientific, candidate, review@1, promotion, or publication approval.
